name: Barbell Seated Behind-the-Neck Press
steps: Sit upright on a bench with feet planted firmly and rest a barbell across your upper traps using a wide overhand grip.
Brace your core, stack your ribs over your hips, and keep your forearms vertical beneath the bar.
Press the bar smoothly straight overhead until your arms extend without locking harshly.
Lower the bar slowly behind your head to ear level or lightly to your upper traps within comfortable shoulder range.
tips: Keep your chin level and head upright rather than jutting your neck forward.
Reverse the descent before you feel any shoulder pinching or need to move your head.
